description:
Note: This children's electric motorcycle is heavy and must be installed carefully by two adults. Before driving, make sure the vehicle is properly installed. The electric motor produces sound waves that imitate rumbling and help increase driving pleasure.
POWER: EVERCROSS electric motorcycles are equipped with a 150 Watt electric motor and a maximum load of 40 kg, suitable for children aged 3 to 12 years old. (Data may vary depending on speed mode, weight, battery, temperature, road conditions, etc.)
MULTI-SPEED AND LONG ENDURANCE: The ultra-long 14.4V and 4Ah battery life of the EVERCROSS EV05M electric motorcycle provides a range of up to 10 km (6.2 miles). The electric motorcycle also has two adjustable speed modes: 8km/h and 16km/h.
PERFECT DESIGN: This children's cross - country motorcycle is equipped with large 12-inch wear-resistant rubber wheels for better grip. The non-slip and high-density seats are ergonomic, softer and more breathable, ensuring a comfortable ride for children.
SAFETY: Children's electric bikes are supported by a solid iron frame, more sturdy and durable. It works with the braking system to ensure the safety of children.
THE BEST GIFT: Give your children this electric motorcycle and let them cultivate their passion for courage, exploration and adventure with excellent driving, under the protection of safety!
